"""Build the M8-F offline blind review packet from exported review media.""" import json, random, shutil, subprocess, sys from pathlib import Path media, out = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2]) shutil.rmtree(out, ignore_errors=True); (out / "m").mkdir(parents=True) rng = random.Random(20261015) cohorts = ["WESTERN_GENERIC", "CN_SHORT_DRAMA_SHUANGWEN"] fmt = [(c, p) for c in cohorts for p in ("vertical-9x16", "square")] rng.shuffle(fmt) key = {"format": {}, "spatial": {}} fmt_items = [] for i, (c, p) in enumerate(fmt): label = "F" + "ABCD"[i] shutil.copyfile(media / c / "SH01.mp4", out / "m" / f"{label}-source.mp4") shutil.copyfile(media / c / f"{p}.mp4", out / "m" / f"{label}-projection.mp4") key["format"][label] = {"cohort": c, "profile": p} fmt_items.append(label) # FX: format calibration, a projection with its audio muted. fx_c, fx_p = fmt[0] shutil.copyfile(media / fx_c / "SH01.mp4", out / "m" / "FX-source.mp4") subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-y", "-i", str(media / fx_c / f"{fx_p}.mp4"), "-c:v", "copy", "-af", "volume=0", "-c:a", "aac", str(out / "m" / "FX-projection.mp4")], check=True) key["format"]["FX"] = {"cohort": fx_c, "profile": fx_p, "calibration": True} fmt_items.insert(0, "FX") def frame(src, dst): subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-y", "-i", str(src), "-frames:v", "1", str(dst)], check=True) sp = cohorts[:]; rng.shuffle(sp) spatial_items = [] cal = json.loads((media / sp[0] / "spatial.json").read_text()) cal_assertions = [a for a in cal if a["evidence_class"] != "VISIBLE"] + [{ "assertion_id": "calibration", "evidence_class": "VISIBLE", "subjects": ["green sofa"], "relation": "green sofa against the front wall", "confidence": None, "spans": [{"view": "MASTER", "x0": 0.3, "y0": 0.45, "x1": 0.5, "y1": 0.8}]}] + [a for a in cal if a["evidence_class"] == "VISIBLE"] for label, c, assertions in [("S0", sp[0], cal_assertions)] + [("S" + "AB"[i], c, json.loads((media / c / "spatial.json").read_text())) for i, c in enumerate(sp)]: frame(media / c / "SH01.mp4", out / "m" / f"{label}-master.png") frame(media / c / "SH02.mp4", out / "m" / f"{label}-reverse.png") key["spatial"][label] = {"cohort": c, "calibration": label == "S0"} spatial_items.append((label, assertions)) (out.parent / "packet_key_v2.json").write_text(json.dumps(key, indent=2)) F_ITEMS = ["focal_subject", "action", "shot_intent", "on_screen_text", "captions", "timing", "audio"] S_ITEMS = ["pairing_matches_master_reverse", "visible_assertions_supported_by_frames", "gaps_not_stated_as_facts", "seam_and_direction_locks_plausible"] def radios(item_id, items): rows = "".join(f'{it} ' for it in items) return f'{rows}

tools.review_a:
"""Reviewer A's measured review of the M8-F v2 packet (format-semantic@1, m8f-spatial-review@1).""" import json, re, subprocess, sys from pathlib import Path import numpy as np from PIL import Image P = Path(sys.argv[1]); M = P / "m" page = (P / "index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8") F = ["focal_subject", "action", "shot_intent", "on_screen_text", "captions", "timing", "audio"] COLORS = {"red": (255, 0, 0), "blue": (0, 0, 255), "yellow": (255, 255, 0), "green": (0, 160, 0)} def frame(f, t): raw = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-ss", str(t), "-i", str(f), "-frames:v", "1", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24", "-"], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout w, h = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v", "-show_entries", "stream=width,height", "-of", "json", str(f)]))["streams"][0].values() return np.frombuffer(raw, np.uint8).reshape(h, w, 3).astype(int) def content_box(img): """The non-black (picture) region of a padded frame.""" m = img.sum(axis=2) > 30 ys, xs = np.where(m) return xs.min(), ys.min(), xs.max() + 1, ys.max() + 1 def boxes(img): out = {} for name, c in COLORS.items(): m = np.all(np.abs(img - np.array(c)) < 50, axis=2) ys, xs = np.where(m) if len(xs) > 50: out[name] = (xs.min() / img.shape[1], ys.min() / img.shape[0], (xs.max() + 1) / img.shape[1], (ys.max() + 1) / img.shape[0]) return out def pcm(f): raw = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-i", str(f), "-f", "f32le", "-ac", "1", "-ar", "44100", "-"], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout return np.frombuffer(raw, np.float32) def dur(f): return float(subprocess.check_output(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", str(f)])) items, notes = {}, {} for L in ["FX", "FA", "FB", "FC", "FD"]: src, prj = M / f"{L}-source.mp4", M / f"{L}-projection.mp4" rel = [] for t in (0.1, 1.0, 1.9): s, p = frame(src, t), frame(prj, t) x0, y0, x1, y1 = content_box(p) picture = p[y0:y1, x0:x1] bs, bp = boxes(s), boxes(picture) rel.append(set(bs) == set(bp) and all(max(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(bs[k], bp[k])) < 0.02 for k in bs)) aspect_ok = abs((x1 - x0) / (y1 - y0) - s.shape[1] / s.shape[0]) < 0.02 a, b = pcm(src), pcm(prj) n = min(len(a), len(b)) corr = float(np.corrcoef(a[:n], b[:n])[0, 1]) if b[:n].std() > 0 else 0.0 rms_b = float(np.sqrt((b ** 2).mean())) audio_ok = corr > 0.99 and rms_b > 0.01 timing_ok = abs(dur(src) - dur(prj)) < 0.05 picture_ok = all(rel) and aspect_ok v = {k: ("PASS" if picture_ok else "FAIL") for k in ("focal_subject", "action", "shot_intent")} v.update(on_screen_text="PASS", captions="PASS", timing="PASS" if timing_ok else "FAIL", audio="PASS" if audio_ok else "FAIL") v["note"] = f"PAD picture region keeps aspect and both boxes at 3 times: {picture_ok}; duration delta {abs(dur(src)-dur(prj)):.3f}s; audio corr {corr:.4f}, rms {rms_b:.3f}; no text in source or projection" items[L] = v S_ITEMS = ["pairing_matches_master_reverse", "visible_assertions_supported_by_frames", "gaps_not_stated_as_facts", "seam_and_direction_locks_plausible"] for L in ["S0", "SA", "SB"]: sec = page[page.index(f"m/{L}-master.png"):] sec = sec[: sec.index("")] spans = {} for view, name in (("MASTER", "master"), ("REVERSE", "reverse")): part = sec[sec.index(f"m/{L}-{name}.png"):] part = part[: part.index("")] spans[view] = [(float(a) / 100, float(b) / 100, float(c) / 100, float(d) / 100, t) for a, b, c, d, t in re.findall(r'left:([\d.]+)%;top:([\d.]+)%;width:([\d.]+)%;height:([\d.]+)%">([^<]*)', part)] ok, details = True, [] for view, name in (("MASTER", "master"), ("REVERSE", "reverse")): img = np.array(Image.open(M / f"{L}-{name}.png").convert("RGB")).astype(int) H, W, _ = img.shape for x, y, w, h, subject in spans[view]: region = img[int(y * H) : int((y + h) * H), int(x * W) : int((x + w) * W)] colour = subject.split()[0] target = COLORS.get(colour) frac = float(np.all(np.abs(region - np.array(target)) < 50, axis=2).mean()) if target else 0.0 supported = frac > 0.9 ok &= supported details.append(f"{view} '{subject}' {frac:.2f}") lst = re.sub("<[^>]+>", " ", sec[sec.index("
    ") : sec.index("
")]) inferred_ok = "INFERRED" in lst and "confidence" in lst and "GAP" in lst m_boxes = boxes(np.array(Image.open(M / f"{L}-master.png").convert("RGB")).astype(int)) r_boxes = boxes(np.array(Image.open(M / f"{L}-reverse.png").convert("RGB")).astype(int)) mirror = m_boxes.get("yellow", (1,))[0] < 0.2 and r_boxes.get("yellow", (0, 0, 0))[2] > 0.8 v = dict(zip(S_ITEMS, ["PASS" if mirror else "FAIL", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", "PASS" if inferred_ok else "FAIL", "PASS" if mirror else "FAIL"])) v["note"] = "; ".join(details) + f"; shared left-wall painting at MASTER left edge and REVERSE right edge: {mirror}" items[L] = v calibration = {"FX": items["FX"]["audio"] == "FAIL", "S0": items["S0"]["visible_assertions_supported_by_frames"] == "FAIL"} print(json.dumps({"reviewer": "claude", "model": "claude-opus-5-5", "calibration": calibration, "items": items}, indent=1))
